title: 第3章 修行第4章 杀土匪
content_zh:
虎妞别想不开，跟着仙人修行，以后就不用吃苦了！”
江平安见虎妞耍脾气，赶忙大喊安慰。
听说仙人可以长生不老，听说仙人可以不用挨饿，听说仙人可以不被官兵欺负。
这是一个机会，一个改变虎妞一生的机会。
虎妞还小，不懂这意味着什么，但江平安知道。
虽然他知道自己被对方看不上很失望，但没关系，自己有聚宝盆，一辈子不愁吃穿也行。
“不要！我就要平安哥！”李月月挥舞着糖葫芦大哭。
女人笑着说道：“你如果不修行，你的平安哥将来也可能被土匪杀死，你想让你的平安哥死吗？”
“不想！”李月月吓得连忙大喊。
江平安是她最后的亲人，她不想失去。
“那就要修行。”
“可是……”
“为了你平安哥的未来幸福，你必须修行，我现在带你走，就是为了你们能再见面。”
女人往下丢了一本没用的呼吸吐纳法和三颗灵石。
“我给了你平安哥修行之法和修行资源，这样他就不会被人欺负。”
李月月还想说什么，女人对着她吹了一口气，李月月顿时昏迷过去。
等这女孩踏上修行，再增长些年纪，就会把这个所谓的平安哥忘掉。
几个女人化作一道流光消失，没有对江平安说任何话，没有任何理会。
看着虎妞被带走，江平安心里空荡荡。
感觉整个世界只剩下他一个人，从此，人生再无归宿。

不过，他也为虎妞开心，以后能够成为仙人，快快乐乐一辈子。
江平安深呼一口气，平复好复杂的心情。
走到神仙丢下来的书和三块晶莹剔透的石头。
对方说这是修行之法和修行资源，感觉很贵重的样子。
难道学会了就能成仙？
能成仙为什么不带走自己？
江平安将东西放回房间，暂时没理会，而是埋葬村民的尸体。
虽然村民平常感情一般，但都对他多多少少有过帮助。
如今大家被杀害，不能让村民烂在外面，被野狗吃掉。
花了一天时间，将村民抬到一个坑中埋下。
李民单独埋在一处，回头弄个碑文，虎妞成仙后或许会回来祭拜，不能让她找不到父亲。
content_en:
Huniu, don’t think too hard, practice with the immortals, and you won’t have to endure hardship in the future! "
Jiang Ping'an saw Huniu showing her temper and quickly shouted to comfort her.
I heard that immortals can live forever, that immortals can live forever, that immortals can avoid starvation, and that immortals can avoid being bullied by officers and soldiers.
This is an opportunity, an opportunity to change Huniu's life.
Huniu was still young and didn't understand what this meant, but Jiang Ping'an knew.
Although he knew that he was disappointed by being looked down upon by the other party, it didn't matter. He had a cornucopia of money and he could have enough food and clothing for the rest of his life.
"No! I want Brother Ping An! "Li Yueyue waved her candied haws and cried.
The woman smiled and said, "If you don't practice cultivation, your brother Ping An may be killed by bandits in the future. Do you want your brother Ping An to die?" "
"In no mood! "Li Yueyue was so frightened that she shouted quickly.
Jiang Ping'an is her last relative and she doesn't want to lose him.
“Then you have to practice. "
"But..."
"For the future happiness of your brother Ping An, you must practice cultivation. I am taking you away now just so that you can meet again. "
The woman threw down a useless breathing method and three spiritual stones.
"I gave you Brother Ping'an the method and resources to practice so that he won't be bullied. "
Li Yueyue wanted to say something else, but the woman blew on her, and Li Yueyue suddenly passed out.
When this girl starts practicing and grows older, she will forget about this so-called Brother Ping An.
Several women turned into a stream of light and disappeared without saying anything or paying attention to Jiang Ping'an.
Seeing Huniu being taken away, Jiang Pingan felt empty.
It felt like he was the only one left in the world, and from then on, his life had no destination.
However, he was also happy for Hu Niu, who could become an immortal and live happily forever.
Jiang Ping'an took a deep breath to calm down his complicated mood.
Go to the book dropped by the fairy and the three crystal clear stones.
The other party said that this was a method of cultivation and a resource for cultivation, and it seemed very precious.
Could it be that if you learn how to do it, you can become an immortal?
Why don't you take yourself away if you can become an immortal?
Jiang Pingan put the things back into the room and ignored them for the time being, but instead buried the villagers' bodies.
Although the villagers were generally unkind, they all helped him to some extent.
Now that everyone is being killed, we cannot let the villagers rot outside and be eaten by wild dogs.
It took a day to carry the villagers to a pit and bury them.
Li Min buried him alone in a place and went back to get an inscription. After Huniu became a fairy, she might come back to worship him, so she could not find her father.
